Here we construct the changes of that actual presentation needed to arrange the handles by index. The [framed slides and index-one removal](framed-handle-slides-and-index-one-removal.md#slide-index-one-cancellation) are now proved in their receiving companion. The [integral handle-chain companion](integral-handle-chains-and-signed-incidences.md#handle-six-seven) now proves the original filtration-to-homology map, every incidence sign, the full integer basis comparisons and the exact contractions in dimensions six and seven.
